checks.name: Full application suite
checks.detail: 1,794 app tests, 5 bundle checks, and 8 balance-patch checks; 1,807 total, zero failures or skips.

checks.name: Wave authority and presentation
checks.detail: 113 checks cover both seats, local/online/replay, JSON persistence, progression, blocked effects, alpha, cache revisions, all 30 portraits, and complete distinct sticker packs.

checks.name: Native API database suite
checks.detail: 292 checks on a fresh owned loopback PostgreSQL cluster with independent connections, zero failures or skips. Includes every campaign node through HTTP. External databases were not used.

checks.name: TypeScript
checks.detail: Application, API server, shared engine, and audit scripts compile. Required workspace declaration projects were built first.

checks.name: Staging release gates
checks.detail: Full build-netlify pipeline with DATABASE_URL unset, staging environment, public origin, and the repository test Clerk publishable key; migration, API function, online, story, media and client bundle gates pass. Its single database-only cosmetics test is covered by the native database run; this does not validate production authentication.

checks.name: Bundle budgets
checks.detail: Public 211.2 / 475 KiB; GameApp 852.1 / 900 KiB; Home 931.1 / 1,200 KiB. Existing budgets are unchanged.

checks.name: Browser interactions
checks.detail: 11 checks and nine screenshots. Real play and End Turn retain visible cards on desktop, phone, and both iPad orientations; music settings persist on repeated opening and Escape closes the dialog; zero page errors.

checks.name: Optimization preserves gameplay
checks.detail: All 6,888 post-optimization match summaries equal their pre-optimization counterparts, including winners, district margins, plays, and passes.

checks.name: Deck diagnostic audit
checks.detail: 42 legal comparison crews, 6,888 matches, both seats, two policies, base/mastery tiers; all 29 new identities covered, zero engine errors. Scores are fixed-seed bot diagnostics, not human win rates.

limitations: One draw rotation and fixed seed, two simple bot policies; not every ten-card combination is covered.
Fitness sequencing remains difficult for the diagnostic bots; its final score is 30.3%. Older Fire and tempo crews remain weaker than Water and Plant in this pool.
Load-size budget and interaction verification do not establish an improvement in battle FPS.

The original wave added overhead to older matches and exceeded a strict campaign solver budget. Stateless adapter reuse and inactive-hook fast exits restore that budget; a direct Soundcheck regression retains the original ceiling.
Two stale API test expectations were aligned with existing mandatory card rewards and current tester promo grants; production reward code was not changed.
